# recompile_buster v0.1.1 - Table of Contents

Mix task that analyzes your xref graph to find modules causing excessive recompilation, and helps you fix them.

## Pages

- [Recompile Buster](https://recompile-buster.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [RecompileBuster](https://recompile-buster.hexdocs.pm/RecompileBuster.md): Mix task that analyzes your xref graph to find modules causing excessive
recompilation, and helps you fix them.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix recompile_buster](https://recompile-buster.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.RecompileBuster.md): Analyzes the xref graph to identify files whose changes cause the most transitive
recompilation. This helps find the "worst offender" modules that create compile-time
coupling across the codebase.
